interpretation: Axiom Ax2b as stated in the theory, the free φ read as universally closed. Its formula is that of Scott's A4 (GoedelGod.thy), so it binds to the same statement; the constant P it constrains is the 1970 theory's. Attributed to the AFP formalization of Gödel's 1970 manuscript (Benzmüller and Scott), not to what Gödel intended.
